title: Bruce Maccabee judged the ARV photographs hoaxes

tellings.quote: I don't remember Bruce mcabe looked at them I know Bruce mcabe had only said um they definitely looked like hoaxes to him

plain: Eric Davis, a physicist, said on Jesse Michels' podcast that some photographs of an ARV, short for "alien reproduction vehicle", a craft said to be built by humans copying alien designs, were shown to a photo analyst named Bruce Maccabee. Davis says Maccabee told him the pictures definitely looked like hoaxes to him. This matters because the photos had been offered as proof that such a craft exists.
